get_risk_score.note: risk_score is the out-of-fold score of the final model (a logistic stack of tuned LightGBM and a wide-and-deep network; it averages the 5.6% fraud rate). It is a model score for ranking, not a verified probability of fraud. risk_rank_pct is the percentile among training clients (higher = riskier). Tier: high = top 1% of clients, medium = top 5% (the monthly inspection budget), low = the rest.
